text:
incident-bot: Pager: High auth error rate detected for /v1/token — 1.2k 401s/s across three IP blocks. Affected region: us-west-2. Pager -> @oncall-andy. :rotating_light:

oncall-andy: taking it. setting P0, will triage. tagging sec-ops + infra. any initial visible customer impact?

sre-maya: looking at metrics now — spike started ~00:58 UTC, source IP clusters: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 192.0.2.128/26. Auth failures correlate with requests that include header `X-Orig-Host: staging.redwood-inference.internal`.

sec-ops: suspend external log forwarding from `staging-logshipper` immediately if possible. suspect leaked staging creds. plan: block IPs at edge + rotate staging service tokens.

alice_db: found a weird forwarder config on staging that points to third-party endpoint — looks like a misconfigured shipper. snippet:

```
# /etc/logshipper/config.yml
forwarder:
  target: https://logs-external.example.com/ingest
  api_key: sk_live_staging_abc123
```

alice_db: that api_key appears to be a staging service token used by the logshipper. may have been exfil'd.

infra-paul: applying denylist to edge WAF now for 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24. command: `curl -sS -X POST https://waf.internal/api/block -d '{"cidrs":["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.0/24"]}'` — rolling out (ETA ~45s).

oncall-andy: @cs-jordan can you check whether any customers have reported degraded auth or data exposure? we need to know scope before notifying customers.

cs-jordan: checked support queue — one customer (acme-corp) reported intermittent 401s in the last 5m, no reports of data leakage yet. I'll stand by for notification guidance.

legal-oncall: preserve all logs and snapshots; set a legal hold on the staging log bucket. DO NOT delete or rotate anything until we snapshot. I'll need copies for initial review.

sec-ops: agreed. next actions: 1) block IP clusters at edge (infra done) 2) snapshot staging logs to safe-hold bucket 3) rotate staging service tokens immediately 4) generate list of forwarded endpoints and contact points. proposing rotation window: now -> thorough rotate in 10m, PR to infra to rotate production keys after confirmation.

oncall-andy: I'll run the staging rotation now with alice_db. @alice_db can you paste the rotation command?

alice_db: running: `redwoodctl secrets rotate --env=staging --service=logshipper --preserve-snapshot=true` — will create new token and update k8s secret (helm: staging-logshipper). I'll also remove external forwarding target from config until we validate.

sec-ops: after rotation, we should invalidate any sessions tied to that service token and rotate any associated S3 presign keys. also check cloudtrail for `PutObject` calls to external endpoints.

infra-paul: WAF denylist applied for two clusters, 3rd cluster (192.0.2.128/26) is in progress. rate impact: initial drop in 401s by ~60% after block, still seeing tail.

sre-maya: monitoring: auth 5xx rate stable, 401s down from peak but ~3% of total auth requests still failing — likely some legit clients using old staging tokens. recommend canary restart of logshipper once secret updated.

oncall-andy: customer impact summary for now: small number of customers (0.5-3%) experienced auth failures; no confirmed data exfil yet but staging token exposure likely. Plan: block + rotate staging tokens, snapshot logs for legal, further investigation into how token left config.

legal-oncall: please tag evidence artifacts with case id: SEC-2026-042. I'll coordinate regulator/customer notification if we confirm exposure. keep chain of custody notes.

incident-bot: Status update: Mitigations in progress — WAF denylist applied, staging token rotation started, staging logs snapshotting. Current impact: partial auth failures (~3% of auth requests in us-west-2). Next update in 10m or on new findings. :white_check_mark:
